'''Yilvas Antos''' is the lord of the merchant [[House Antos]] in [[Bandar Eban]].

== History ==
Lord Yilvas wished to expand the influence of his House, and thus arranged for a marriage between his youngest daughter [[Meka Antos|Meka]] and [[Lorwyn Kilvar]], the son of the ruling house of [[Ostin Falls]], a town on the border of [[Toman Head]] and [[Almoth Plain]]. The Antos House viewed this as an opportunity to access more raw materials, while also increasing the market for the manufactured goods that they produced.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
